datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular monthly surveys across Rwanda to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications (scenarios) were compiled for October, November, and December 2020 as medium-term projections, with spatial boundaries and classification values recorded for each assessment period.
